note: Both sets contain the same 25 claims in different order, with identical values, conditions and quotes, all supported by the page. Both split the display-size requirements into separate inch and centimetre claims (TV 27 in. / 68.6 cm, computer 15 in. / 38.1 cm), so both state each fact twice. Both also omit the same facts (no required volume setting, laptop or desktop computer allowed, observer spot checks, the common-allergies list). No claim in either set is misread, misbound or invented.
remarks: The two extractions are effectively identical modulo ordering and minor attribute wording ('minimum manufacturer stated display size' vs 'minimum size' with the manufacturer condition). Both treat the dual-unit display sizes as two claims each, which is a duplication pattern worth normalizing. Facts both sets miss: 'There is no required volume setting', 'The computer may be a laptop or desktop computer', observer spot checks of TV content/brightness, and the enumerated common food allergies.
